scientific_limitations: Restricted to finite nonempty meets of nonempty pure product monomials over a fixed finite variable set, represented by explicit nonzero exponent vectors. Terms with nested meet inside product, join, finite parallelization, the constant 1, empty meets, and empty products are outside the theorem.
